dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, gradual 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; the lateral margins where the skin meets the water appear smooth and devoid of bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity normalized pixel values across the entire visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A faint, thin, diagonal linear mark of lower contrast extending from the right lateral margin toward the dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A subtle longitudinal linear shadow along the posterior midline, indicative of the dorsal ridge structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single diagonal linear mark/scar on the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark oval aperture representing the blowhole at the anterior end of the visible dorsal plane.
